Title: Can someone explain the wording: Pentex Subversion

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
I'm not asking how the card is played; that I already know. I'm asking about the history (and possible migration? legacy?) of text for this card. It's the bolded part in the beginning that gets me. It seems so... extraneous.

Since the meth who plays the card is the target for the  action to remove it (because of card ownership), what's with this extra text? Couldn't it have been better written "Put this card in play and target a ready minion"? As a visual reminder of who is 'Pentex'ed it just adds visual confusion when I explain to new players that that reminder has no bearing on who you are targeting with the  action to remove the card. But at some point was there a reason?

At this point, I don't really care about current rulings about it. VTES is chock full of quirks that at this point are essentially delightful apocrypha. But I'm rather intrigued by the story behind the text's legacy. It's sorta like why I find Phobia or Mummify interesting as a legacy narrative.

Pentex(TM) Subversion
Master
Unique master.
Put this card on any ready minion. The minion with this card cannot take actions and cannot block actions. This card may be burned by any other minion as a  action.

So, VTES historians, what's the story here?

Messages.Author: Otso
Messages.Body: I don't know about the history of the card, but the question whether the card is put on a minion is a nontrivial one. I guess the most common situation where this could be seen is when the minion with the card leaves play causing all cards on the minion to be burned and making it possible to play another pentex without contesting.

Messages.Author: Pagan
Messages.Body:
Likely old WotC wording and the fact that the card better represents the game state being attached to the target minion.

It also allows it to interact with at least one card that the alternative text would not, although I can't say that I've ever seen it happen.

Cleansing Ritual
Type: Action
Requires: Obeah/Dominate
Cost: 1 blood
+1 stealth action.
[dom] Add 1 blood to a vampire you control.
[obe] Burn a card on an ally or younger vampire in your ready region.
[OBE] As [obe] above, and untap that minion at the end of the turn.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
I think maybe the old text of secure haven also may have had "master cards played on this vampire" instead of "targetting". So it would affect pentex only if pentex was played on the vampire. I probably have a DS version of both I could check if I could be bothered...
